startTime = system.date.now()
	
	# read in needed tags
	tags = system.tag.readBlocking(
		[
			'%s/History/History' % value.heatmapFolder
			,'%s/Tags/Tags' % value.heatmapFolder
		]
	)
	historyDataset = tags[0].value
	tagsDataset = tags[1].value
	
	# find index in history dataset
	index = None
	if self.custom.slider.time >= self.custom.slider.range.max:
		index = historyDataset.getRowCount() - 1
	else:
		for i in xrange(historyDataset.getRowCount()):
			if system.date.toMillis(historyDataset.getValueAt(i,0)) == value.time:
				index = i
				break

	# if index exists parse into object format
	data = []
	rowInfo = []
	if index:
		lastAisle = None
		for i in xrange(tagsDataset.getRowCount()):
			if str(tagsDataset.getValueAt(i,0)).endswith(value.tagConfig.name):
				currentAisle = tagsDataset.getValueAt(i,'aisle')
				dsValue = historyDataset.getValueAt(index, i + 1)
				if currentAisle == lastAisle:
					data[-1].append(dsValue)
				else:
					data.append([dsValue])
					rowInfo.append((tagsDataset.getValueAt(i,'aisleName'), tagsDataset.getValueAt(i,'isCold')))
				
				lastAisle = currentAisle
	
	# transform data into view instances
	aisleInstances = []
	for i, (row, info) in enumerate(zip(data, rowInfo)):
		template = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.custom.aisleTemplate))
		template['config']['highSetpoint'] = value.tagConfig.engHigh
		template['config']['lowSetpoint'] = value.tagConfig.engLow
		template['ambientValue'] = (value.tagConfig.engHigh + value.tagConfig.engLow) / 2.0
		template['values'] = row
		template['units'] = value.tagConfig.engUnit
		template['name'] = info[0]
		template['isColdAisle'] = info[1]
		if value.time == value.alarm.time:
			template['alarms'] = value.alarm.sensorMap[i]
			
		# append rack view
		if i > 0:
			aisleInstances.append({'inputs':{
				"bottomPduName": "PDU%dB" % i,
				"bottomPduPath": value.heatmapFolder.replace('Heatmap/Summary',"PDU/PDU%dB" % i),
				"topPduName": "PDU%dA" % i,
				"topPduPath": value.heatmapFolder.replace('Heatmap/Summary',"PDU/PDU%dA" % i)
				},'isAisle': False})
				
		# append aisle view
		aisleInstances.append({'inputs':template,'isAisle': True})
	
	# output
	return {
		'index':index
		,'retrievedAt': system.date.now()
		,'indexTimestamp': system.date.fromMillis(value.time)
		,'data': data
		,'aisleInstances': aisleInstances
		,'calcTimeMs':system.date.millisBetween(startTime, system.date.now())
	}

#	output = 'linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0.0, 0.0, 255.0, 1.0), rgba(25.0, 25.0, 152.5, 1.0), rgba(50.0, 50.0, 50.0, 1.0), rgba(152.5, 25.0, 25.0, 1.0), rgba(255.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0))'
	gradient = 'linear-gradient(to right, rgba(%s, %s, %s, %s), rgba(%s, %s, %s, %s), rgba(%s, %s, %s, %s))'
	output = gradient % (
		value.lowColor.r, value.lowColor.g, value.lowColor.b, value.lowColor.a,
		value.midColor.r, value.midColor.g, value.midColor.b, value.midColor.a,
		value.highColor.r, value.highColor.g, value.highColor.b, value.highColor.a
	)
	return output

config.script:
self.view.custom.alarm.time = None
	self.view.custom.alarm.alarmName = None
	
	try:
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Footer").getChild("Table").props.selection.selectedColumn = None
		self.parent.parent.getChild("Footer").getChild("Table").props.selection.selectedRow = None
	except:
		pass

system.perspective.print(str(event))
	self.view.custom.slider.timeSlider = event.value.Time
	self.view.custom.alarm = {
		 'time': event.value.Time
		,'alarmName': event.value.AlarmName
		,'tagName': event.value.TagName
		,'sensorMap': system.util.jsonDecode(event.value.SensorMap)
		,'sensorList': event.value.SensorList
	}
	system.perspective.navigate('/heat-map/%s/%s' % (self.view.params.heatmap, event.value.TagName))

onChange.script:
col = None
	row = None
	
	ds = currentValue.value
	if ds is not None and self.view.custom.alarm.time != None and self.view.custom.alarm.alarmName != None and self.view.custom.alarm.tagName != None:
		for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
			if (
				long(self.view.custom.alarm.time) == system.date.toMillis(ds.getValueAt(i,'Time')) 
				and self.view.custom.alarm.alarmName == ds.getValueAt(i,'AlarmName')
				and self.view.custom.alarm.tagName == ds.getValueAt(i,'TagName')
				):
				col = 'Time'
				row = i
				break

	self.props.selection.selectedColumn = col
	self.props.selection.selectedRow = row
